title: Gymmi AI
lines: Workout planning and progress tracking
A public student MVP with Supabase accounts

Matan Roditi
AI Development final project

title: A weekly plan becomes visible progress
lines: 01  Plan the week with dates, duration and routine details.
02  Complete a workout and record its actual status.
03  See the completed share of your weekly plan.
04  Sign in on another device to load the same journal.
Example: one completed workout out of three planned.

title: A small product works end to end
lines:
Weekly planning
Add, edit and delete your workouts.

Progress and history
Complete, skip or undo a status.

Private cloud journal
Sign up, sign in and load another device.

RPG-inspired interface
A journey panel, quest cards and clear status badges.

title: Simple code connects to managed services
lines:
Browser
HTML and CSS display the app.
app.js handles actions and state.

Supabase Auth
Email and password create a session.
The session identifies the user.

Postgres with RLS
One JSON journal per account.
Database rules enforce ownership.
GitHub Pages serves the public HTTPS app. cloud.js reads and writes Supabase.

title: A save needs a server acknowledgment
lines: 01  Validate dates, required fields and the backup format.
02  Send the journal with the revision that the browser loaded.
03  Update the visible journal only after the server accepts it.
04  Reject stale writes and preserve the form draft on network failure.

title: 24 scenario groups cover the user journey
lines: Browser checks use real Supabase and disposable QA accounts.
The results describe executed checks. Hosted test CI is not configured.

title: A five-minute demo tells the story
lines: Open the public app and register a new account.
Add three workouts, then complete one dated today or earlier.
Show the progress, history and persistence after reload.
Sign in with a separate browser to load the same cloud journal.

title: A focused MVP follows the clarified brief
lines: Production: a public HTTPS app and a public GitHub repository.
Core product: workout planning, completion and weekly progress.
RPG today: visual style. Avatars, XP and levels remain future work.
AI and ML: earlier optional research, inactive in the public app.
Known limits: unverified emails, no password recovery and manual refresh.
